name: lifecycle-reconcile
description: Flow 13. The weekly BACKSTOP over the indexed fields (plan 5.3): the lifecycle is driven by per-entity timers and record events, and this scan exists only to find the cases those lost. Six index scans - timers pending/failed, void deadline passed with the notice unsent, invoices past due and unpaid, ISSUED decisions past validity, policies still ACTIVE past expiry, and ageing board work - then one de-duplicating report. A NON-EMPTY result is an exception report and is emailed; an empty one is a silent success and is still visible in the run result. Schedule trigger, trigger_every 168h, installed at publish time. Every filter is a POSITIVE match against the STORED case of a keyword field: the index has no negation, and a lowercased keyword returns a silent zero.
